lines.af: Winterlug: die berge lyk naby genoeg om aan te raak. Steeds te koud om te swem.
lines.en: Winter air: the mountains look close enough to touch. Still too cold to swim.

lines.af: Iemand gaan nou-nou sê 'verfrissend'. Moenie hulle glo nie.
lines.en: Someone is about to say 'refreshing'. Do not believe them.

lines.af: Een kombers, twee mense. Onderhandelinge duur voort.
lines.en: One blanket, two people. Negotiations are ongoing.

lines.af: 'n Beskuitjie doop jy stadig in koue weer. Dis nie 'n reël nie, dis 'n kultuur.
lines.en: You dunk a rusk slowly in cold weather. It's not a rule, it's a culture.

lines.af: Die stoep is die warmste kamer in die huis. Dink daaroor.
lines.en: The stoep is the warmest room in the house. Sit with that.

lines.af: Jou asem maak wolkies. Gratis spesiale effekte, hele winter lank.
lines.en: Your breath is making clouds. Free special effects, all winter long.

lines.af: Vrystaat-koue: droog, eerlik, en persoonlik.
lines.en: Free State cold: dry, honest, and personal.

lines.af: Die uitsig is die beloning. Die gevoel in jou vingers kom later terug.
lines.en: The view is the reward. The feeling in your fingers returns later.

lines.af: Padstal-pannekoek in die winter is nie 'n versnapering nie, dis noodhulp.
lines.en: Padstal pancakes in winter aren't a snack, they're first aid.

lines.af: Die Karoo het twee seisoene: warm genoeg om te kla, en dit.
lines.en: The Karoo has two seasons: hot enough to complain about, and this.

lines.af: Kaneelsuiker los meer probleme op as wat mense wil erken.
lines.en: Cinnamon sugar solves more problems than people are willing to admit.

lines.af: Selfs die kat het besluit buite is 'n fout.
lines.en: Even the cat has decided outside was a mistake.

lines.af: Die bakkie gaan môreoggend twee keer hoes voor hy vat. Boek dit.
lines.en: The bakkie is going to cough twice before it starts tomorrow. Book it.

lines.af: Gordyne toe, kaggel aan, wêreld af.
lines.en: Curtains closed, fire on, world off.

lines.af: Die Atlantiese Oseaan is altyd hierdie koud. Vanaand het die lug net besluit om saam te speel.
lines.en: The Atlantic is always this cold. Tonight the air just decided to match it.

lines.af: Draffers in langbroeke: die amptelike teken dat winter ernstig is.
lines.en: Joggers in long pants: the official sign that winter means business.

lines.af: Die hond is in sy element. Die mens is in vier lae.
lines.en: The dog is in his element. The human is in four layers.

lines.af: Sop-seisoen is amptelik oop. Alle ander etes is opgeskort.
lines.en: Soup season is officially open. All other meals are suspended.

lines.af: Die huis met die potjie op die stoof wen vanaand die buurt.
lines.en: The house with the pot on the stove wins the neighbourhood tonight.

lines.af: Binne daardie prentjie is dit ook koud. Hulle staan net naby die stoof vir oorlewing.
lines.en: It's cold inside that picture too. They're just standing near the stove for survival.

lines.af: Hout indra is die winter se gym-sessie.
lines.en: Carrying in firewood is winter's gym session.

lines.af: Die hond dra een stokkie en is trotser as al die mense saam.
lines.en: The dog carries one twig and is prouder than all the humans combined.

lines.af: Vanaand se agenda: vuur, kos, kombers, klaar.
lines.en: Tonight's agenda: fire, food, blanket, done.

lines.af: Komberse aan tafel. Ons is verby skaamte, ons is by oorlewing.
lines.en: Blankets at the dinner table. We are past shame, we are into survival.

lines.af: Die stoof maak die kos warm én die kombuis. Dubbelverdiener.
lines.en: The stove heats the food and the kitchen. Double income.

lines.af: Ouma het gesê trek 'n trui aan. Ouma het, soos altyd, reg gehad.
lines.en: Gran said put on a jersey. Gran was, as always, right.

lines.af: Koue stop nie 'n braai nie. Dit skuif net die mense nader aan die vuur.
lines.en: Cold doesn't stop a braai. It just moves the people closer to the fire.

lines.af: Een vriend het binne gebly. Ons noem hom die verstandige een. Sag.
lines.en: One friend stayed inside. We call him the sensible one. Quietly.

lines.af: Winterbraai-reël: die tang word gedeel, die hitte word nie.
lines.en: Winter braai rule: the tongs get shared, the heat does not.

lines.af: Een kombers, twee mense, een hond. Volmaakte verhouding.
lines.en: One blanket, two humans, one dog. The perfect ratio.

lines.af: Die afstandbeheer is aan die ander kant van die kamer. Dis nou vir ewig daar.
lines.en: The remote is on the other side of the room. It lives there now.

lines.af: Ryp teen die ruite beteken net een ding: niemand gaan êrens heen nie.
lines.en: Frost on the windows means one thing only: nobody is going anywhere.

lines.af: As die rook reguit op staan, bly jy reguit in die bed lê.
lines.en: When the chimney smoke goes straight up, you stay straight in bed.

lines.af: Windstil is net 'n mooi woord vir vrieskas.
lines.en: 'Perfectly still' is just a polite word for freezer.

lines.af: Iewers binne is dit lekker. Buite is net vir kyk.
lines.en: Somewhere inside, it's cosy. Outside is display only.

lines.af: Selfs die perde stoom vanoggend.
lines.en: Even the horses are steaming this morning.

lines.af: Die Midlands doen winter soos 'n skildery. 'n Baie koue skildery.
lines.en: The Midlands does winter like a painting. A very cold painting.

lines.af: Binne daardie venster is die beste plek in die land vanaand.
lines.en: Inside that window is currently the best location in the country.

lines.af: Kaggelweer. Amptelik. Die app sê so.
lines.en: Fireplace weather. Official. The app said so.

lines.af: Die sterre is pragtig. Bewonder hulle deur die venster.
lines.en: The stars are stunning. Admire them through the window.

lines.en: Midlands mist: the countryside's privacy setting.
lines.af: Midlands-mis: die platteland se privaatheid-instelling.

lines.en: Walk now or don't walk at all. The Lowveld gives you until seven.
lines.af: Stap nou of stap glad nie. Die Laeveld gee jou tot sewe-uur.

lines.en: Even the impala are standing in the shade rethinking their choices.
lines.af: Selfs die rooibokke staan in die skadu en heroorweeg hul keuses.

lines.en: Lowveld summer: you don't sweat, you melt with dignity.
lines.af: Laeveld-somer: jy sweet nie, jy smelt met waardigheid.

lines.en: The bushveld is on silent mode today. Everyone. Everything.
lines.af: Die bosveld is vandag op stille modus. Almal. Alles.

lines.en: Sundowners aren't a luxury in the Lowveld. They're medical.
lines.af: Sundowners is nie 'n luukse in die Laeveld nie. Dis medies.

lines.en: Gqeberha, we know. We know.
lines.af: Gqeberha, ons weet. Ons wéét.

lines.en: The Friendly City never asked to be the Windy City, and yet.
lines.af: Die Vriendelike Stad het nie gevra om die Winderige Stad te wees nie, en tog.

lines.en: Jeffreys Bay: where the wind warms up before its Cape Town shift.
lines.af: Jeffreysbaai: waar die wind oefen voor sy Kaapse skof.

lines.en: Gqeberha doesn't sleep, it just holds on.
lines.af: Gqeberha slaap nie, dit hou net vas.
